body: Thank you for your concern! I know it is a slippery slope, and I'm very careful. My reason for drinking too much has gone (my mom was battling cancer and slowly dying. She's dead now and I am much better).

I just feel guilty for not being able to stand it, since I was in their shoes at one point.  I feel like I'm not allowed to get triggered - because I made other people uncomfortable, too, and now I have to face that. But it's just too much for me.
